title: Metaworth
tagline: A no-code platform for meta creators to batch minting and tracking their NFT assets, and launch social tokens all-in-one place.
description: A no-code platform for meta creators to batch minting and tracking their NFT assets, and launch social tokens (distribute tokens to their community instantly, by completing certain tasks or even just claim the token via a URL) all-in-one place. That's what about the project it is.
how_its_made: This project uses the skynet github actions to deploy and build automatically when the changes are pushed up, the users can use metaworth.eth to access deployed content or by using a skynet link, users also can add this dApp to their Homescreen just by clicking a button in README. The eth.storage is used for the images storage, moralis as the web3 frontend lib to interact with the smart contracts. Used Pocket RPC to get the balance of the connected wallet, and used the NFTPort to deploy and retrieve NFT contracts automatically if they don't have one.
